title: New stable release? Latest stable is always 1.76.20 (2019-04-12) with a lot of vulnerabilities
author: Neustradamus
body_snippet:
Dear @mRemoteNG team,

After several requests, tickets, ...

When a new stable version will be released with CVE fixes?

RECALL: Currently, the latest is always 1.76.20 (2019-04-12) with a lot of vulnerabilities.

Thanks in advance.

comments.author: cremenescu
comments.snippet:
To help with the release candidate, I went through the test suite on `v1.78.2-dev` (e3b0108e). On a GitHub Windows runner, 247 of its 2362 tests fail. Most of them come down to a few causes, some of them bugs users would hit, so I opened a PR for each:

- #3597: the CSV export writes `RedirectDiskDrivesCustomRedirectPorts` as a single header column (a separator missing since 2023). An exported CSV imports with every later column shifted, and since `PluginData` is parsed as JSON the import fails ...
